oscillation.source: PEANUTS pinned examples/solar_test.yaml Neutrinos; explicit project benchmark selection, paper2601 does not print its oscillation input card
oscillation.theta23_and_delta: not needed: mu/tau have equal SM cross sections in real ee-only vector NSI subspace

physics.neutron_density_approximation: nn=rho_mass*N_A-ne; one atomic mass unit per baryon

statistics.source: paper2601 PDF p20 Eq88 and exact printed percentages
statistics.data_meaning: fitted signal yields; no explicit background or raw-count Poisson
statistics.minimum: joint parameter minimum; do not subtract SM chi2 or sum separately minimized datasets

xenon_tail.definition: epsilon(last) constant for T>last up to3keV; project assumption, not experimental data
xenon_tail.profile_bounds: at each parameter point use allowed [known,known+unselected_tail] signal interval; additional unpenalized unknown-tail nuisance, not exact paper likelihood
